sections.heading: Why Tools & APIs
sections.content: Modern AI apps compose multiple capabilities: text generation, embeddings, speech, vision, and vector databases. Understanding the tooling helps you choose the right building blocks.

sections.heading: Common Providers
content: OpenAI API: text, embeddings, audio, image
HuggingFace Inference: hosted models and pipelines
Local Inference (LM Studio): private, offline development
Vector DBs: FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone (for retrieval)

definitions.definition: Turns text into vectors for search/retrieval

sections.heading: Hands‑on
sections.description: Open the API Config module and verify your provider works (ItemAI, OpenAI or OpenRouter). Try a small completion call and an embeddings call.
steps: Pick your provider (ItemAI, OpenAI or OpenRouter)
Send: embeddings('hello world') and inspect vector length
